chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz, from al-Khaybari, from Yunus ibn Zabyan, and Mufaddal ibn Umar, and Abu Salamah al-Sarraj, and al-Husayn ibn Thuwayr ibn Abi Fakhitah, who said:

We were in the presence of Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, and he said: “With us are the treasures of the earth and its keys, and if I wished to say with one of my legs, ‘Bring out what is within you of gold,’ it would surely bring it out.”

He said: Then he gestured with one of his legs and traced a line with it upon the ground, and the earth split open. Then he gestured with his hand, and a gold ingot of about a handspan came out. Then he said, “Look carefully.” So we looked, and there were many ingots, some of them upon others, glittering.

Then one of us said to him, “May I be your ransom, you have been given what you have been given, while your Shi'ah are in need.” He said: “Indeed, Allah will gather for us and for our Shi'ah the world and the Hereafter, and He will admit them into the Gardens of Bliss, and He will admit our enemy into the Blaze.”

key_terms.الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةَ: the world and the Hereafter, indicating comprehensive divine favor
key_terms.الذَّهَبِ: gold, the material brought forth from the earth in the narration
key_terms.الْجَحِيمَ: the Blaze, the punishment mentioned for the Imam’s enemies
key_terms.جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ: Gardens of Bliss, the promised reward in the Hereafter
key_terms.خَزَائِنُ الْأَرْضِ: the treasures of the earth, indicating hidden worldly resources under divine control
key_terms.سَبِيكَةَ ذَهَبٍ: a gold ingot, a visible sign produced in front of the narrators
key_terms.شِيعَتِنَا: our Shi'ah, the followers affiliated with the Imam
key_terms.مَفَاتِيحُهَا: its keys, meaning access and authority over those treasures

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the Imam’s access to the earth’s treasures and the fate of his Shi'ah?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a manifestation of the extraordinary authority and divinely granted capacity of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام over the treasures of the earth. It also links this sign to the ultimate promise that Allah will grant goodness in this world and the Hereafter to the Imam and his Shi'ah, while the enemies of the Ahl al-Bayt will face punishment.
